## The job the skill would do

<!-- One job, stated as an outcome: what a builder would be able to do correctly with this skill that they cannot do correctly now. A skill owns one job — if your request contains two jobs, file two requests. -->

## The failure it prevents

<!-- What goes wrong today without this skill? Give a concrete instance: a project or task where the absence of this skill produced (or would produce) a wrong, fake, insecure, or low-quality result. -->

## Proposed owning department

<!-- Which department (D1–D18) should own this skill, and why that department rather than a neighbouring one? Check SKILLS_INDEX.md first: name the closest existing skills and state what they do not cover. If an existing skill should be extended instead of a new one created, say so and name it. -->

## Dependencies

<!-- Which existing skills this one would need loaded first (Depends on), and which skills would consume its output (Feeds into). Every name must be a skill that exists in the catalog. -->

## Sources

<!-- The real sources the skill's rules would be grounded in: official documentation, specifications, or standards, with URLs. A skill with no verifiable sources cannot be written — claims in this repo require a source. -->
